title: SK Telecom holds massive Anthropic stake amid AI and telecom growth #SKM #AnthropicIPO #AIinvestment
description:
Anthropic filed to go public, highlighting SK Telecom (ticker SKM) as an indirect way to gain significant exposure to the AI startup. SK Telecom’s $100 million investment in Anthropic in 2023 has grown to an estimated $2.7 billion, representing about 20% of SKM’s total market cap.

This stake places SK Telecom in a unique position, combining its core telecom business with valuable AI exposure. Without the Anthropic investment, SKM trades at a lower multiple compared to peers like Verizon and AT&T. Additionally, SK Telecom's partnership with NVIDIA aims to build AI infrastructure in Korea, enhancing its strategic role in the AI ecosystem.

If Anthropic's IPO valuation exceeds $1 trillion, SK Telecom could see substantial upside, offering investors a hybrid play on telecom and next-generation AI growth long before broader market recognition.
